questions.subject: CW13 marked L-18 (precast block lintel) on an ICF opening
questions.issue: CW13 (2875 wide, head +2400) is an opening in the external 150mm-core ICF wall. It is marked L-18, which the lintel schedule gives as a Naylor precast lintel R8 (140x215) / R7 (215x145) for 140/215 blockwork. The matching opening CW14 in the same wall is L-10 (300x150 RC, 2-H12 top / 2-H16 bott.).
questions.question: Please confirm the lintel for CW13: is L-18 intended, or should it be an RC lintel cast in the ICF core (e.g. as L-10)?

questions.subject: D1: steel B-6 as the head of the 5575 opening (confirm interpretation)
questions.issue: D1 is the 5575 wide full-length opening in the ICF wall between the conservatory and the room to its east (Wall 21). Your drawing gives it no lintel mark and shows B-6 254x254x73 UC S355 (with 200x100x10 ledger angle one side) along that line. We have modelled B-6 at BOS +2400 / TOS +2654 as the head of the opening, with the structural opening in the ICF up to +2654 and ICF over the steel to the wall top at +3350, giving 2400 clear under the steel.
questions.question: Please confirm that B-6 forms the head of D1 as described (clear opening 2400 under B-6, ICF bearing on the steel above), or advise the intended arrangement.
